messages:
jess: Anyone see why the staging terraform plan keeps showing a full replace of the redis module after the provider bump? plan also failed once with a state lock error when I tried to re-import.
omar: Which workspace/backend? remote state or local?
jess: staging workspace, S3 backend + DynamoDB locks. I ran a manual import yesterday for a credential secret and I think something got left behind.
infra-oncall: I can see a long-lived lock entry in the DynamoDB table owned by `jenkins-run-482` — maybe the CI job never cleared.
jess: plan output snippet -> `# module.redis.aws_elasticache_replication_group.main must be replaced` and earlier: `Error: Error locking state: ConditionalCheckFailedException` when reimporting.
li: Can you paste the provider block for that module? provider alias mismatch often causes `state` to point at the old provider.
jess: here:
```
provider "aws" { region = "us-west-2" }
module "redis" { source = "./modules/redis" providers = { aws = aws.staging } }
```
(just simplified)
omar: If the state was written by `aws` without the `staging` alias, mapping is needed. Try `terraform state replace-provider 'registry.terraform.io/-/aws' 'registry.terraform.io/-/aws@4.0.0'` adjusted for the exact provider addresses, then `terraform refresh -target=module.redis`.
jess: ok i'll try replace-provider. quick q: do I need to force-unlock first or after replace-provider?
infra-oncall: Don't force-unlock while CI holds the lock. I'm pausing the Jenkins run now for 10m so you can operate safely.
buildbot: deploy-bot: Lock acquired: terraform/staging by jenkins-run-482 (started 12m ago)
jess: thanks - paused. running `terraform state replace-provider` now...
jess: replace-provider completed. ran `terraform refresh -target=module.redis` -> no taint flagged. doing a `terraform plan` now and plan is clean.
omar: nice job. :thumbsup:
jess: I'll run apply once CI confirms no other jobs. adding note to the runbook about checking provider aliases when importing resources to avoid this next time.
infra-oncall: Good call — also adding a small check in the lock-monitoring script to alert on >5m stale locks.
jess: thanks everyone, closing the loop.
